articles.title: Can Harassment Risk Alone Support Obviousness-Type Double Patenting?
articles.content:
by Dennis Crouch

With the USPTO's recent brief, In re Ablynx N.V., No. 2026-1333 (Fed. Cir.) is now teed up for the Federal Circuit to decide the nationwide policy on obviousness-type double patenting.  The case particularly asks whether an ODP rejection may be "based solely on the risk of harassment by multiple assignees."

  • Ablynx USPTO Brief

Read my take below.
